subject_session: sub-LA11, ses-2 (prototype); 4 other animals launched but never completed

headline_stat.name: Prototype units significantly frequency-tuned (one-way ANOVA p<0.01)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000986 is a canonical mouse auditory-cortex pure-tone Neuropixels dataset, exactly right for demonstrating frequency tuning.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile with correct trial-onset alignment and matched baseline/response windows, but units are used without any explicit isolation-quality filtering.
justification.analysis: One-way ANOVA on trial-wise evoked rate across the five frequencies is the appropriate and correctly-implemented test, though the population/multi-animal portion that would have strengthened it never ran.
justification.correctness: The prototype value (81/132) reproduces and the example curves are internally consistent, but the claimed multi-session/5-mouse results cannot be traced to any committed figure or output because that analysis never completed.
justification.figures: The two committed figures are readable and three example units show clean tuning, but two of five examples (units 50, 98) are essentially untuned, Panel B mislabels ~0.8 s trial windows as 25 ms tones, and the intended population figures are absent.
justification.honesty: The Results narrative presents completed multi-animal population findings ('consistent across animals,' population heatmap structure) that were never computed and describes figures that do not exist, and labels near-flat units as frequency-selective, with no limitation stated.
justification.verdict: The single-session demonstration is genuinely sound, but the write-up overclaims unfinished multi-session work and would require actually running that analysis and correcting the examples before the stated conclusion could be believed.
